component.name: 4k free video dowloader
component.summary: Download 4K/8K videos, playlists, and audio powered by yt-dlp and ffmpeg
Téléchargez des vidéos 4K/8K, playlists et pistes audio avec yt-dlp et ffmpeg

description.p: 4k free video dowloader (vidgrab) is a lightweight, 100% open-source Rust desktop and headless CLI downloader built with Tauri 2, WebKitGTK, yt-dlp, and ffmpeg.
4k free video dowloader (vidgrab) est un téléchargeur vidéo/audio léger, open source et 100 % Rust (interface Tauri 2 + CLI headless), propulsé par yt-dlp et ffmpeg.

ul.li: Lossless FLAC, MP3 320kbps, Opus, and multi-track audio extraction
Built-in channel/playlist subscriptions and FFmpeg post-processing toolbox
Headless CLI (`vidgrab-cli`) for servers, containers, Alpine/musl, and Raspberry Pi

description.p: Security & distribution release: unified GPL-3.0-or-later licensing, restrictive WebView CSP & capabilities, pinned Flatpak yt-dlp SHA-256, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and native Windows x64 support.

Universal Linux support across Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS, Fedora, RHEL, Alma, Rocky, openSUSE, Arch, CachyOS, Manjaro, Gentoo, Alpine, Void, NixOS, Guix, Solus, Slackware, Bazzite, SteamOS, Nobara, Tails, Qubes, Raspberry Pi OS, Flatpak, Snap, and AppImage.
